get.description: Every imported spec version with its content counts.

post.description: Set a student's password and sign them out of every device.

Sign in with a username (student) or email (guardian/admin).

Rate-limited per IP and per account identifier, on top of the per-account
lockout after repeated failures.
Sign out: revoke this session's refresh tokens and clear cookies. Idempotent.
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token.

get.description: Boards, subjects and current specs for the setup screen.
The student's chosen subjects and their status.

put.description: Save the setup screen. Replaces the whole list; safe to repeat.

get.description: The topic map for one of the student's active subjects.

post.description: The current question for this topic, or a new one. Safe to repeat.
Mark an answer. Repeating with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same result.
Report "this looks wrong". The question is hidden until reviewed.
Reveal the next hint ("I'm stuck"). The fourth is the full solution.

get.description:
Return a user the caller is allowed to see.

Admins can see anyone; guardians their linked students; others only
themselves. Anything else is reported as not found.
